question: Identify the athlete incorrectly matched with their sport at National Games 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarabjot Singh – Swimming**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Sarabjot Singh** is not associated with swimming; instead, he is an accomplished Indian shooter specializing in **10m Air Pistol events.**
 
• He gained recognition by winning multiple medals in national and international shooting championships, showcasing his talent in the shooting discipline.
 
• The incorrect pairing of Sarabjot Singh with swimming highlights a mismatch, as his professional accomplishments are in shooting
